record.original_question: What is the image of the entropy map H: PD_n → SubMod_n given by H(Σ)_I = -log det(Σ_I) for each principal minor Σ_I of a positive definite symmetric matrix, how does that image intersect the faces of the submodular cone SubMod_n, and what are the fibers of H?

evidence.quote: Between these two cones we have the entropy map H : PDn → SubModn, which is given by the logarithms of all 2^n principal minors of a positive definite matrix Σ = (σij ). Namely, the coordinates of the entropy map are H(Σ)I = −log det(ΣI ).
General Problem: Characterize the image of the entropy map H and how it intersects the various faces of SubModn. Study the fibers of this map.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 1$ and let $\mathrm{PD}_n$ denote the open cone of real symmetric positive definite $n\times n$ matrices. For a subset $I\subseteq[n]:=\{1,\dots,n\}$ and $\Sigma=(\sigma_{ij})\in\mathrm{PD}_n$, write $\Sigma_I$ for the principal submatrix of $\Sigma$ indexed by rows and columns in $I$, with the convention $\det(\Sigma_\emptyset)=1$.

Let $\mathrm{SubMod}_n\subset\mathbb{R}^{2^{[n]}}$ denote the submodular cone, i.e. the set of functions $h:2^{[n]}\to\mathbb{R}$ satisfying $h(\emptyset)=0$ and
$$h(I\cup J)+h(I\cap J)\le h(I)+h(J)\qquad\text{for all }I,J\subseteq[n].$$

Define the entropy map
$$H:\mathrm{PD}_n\longrightarrow\mathrm{SubMod}_n,\qquad H(\Sigma)_I=-\tfrac12\log\det(\Sigma_I)\;\text{(equivalently, up to a constant, }-\log\det(\Sigma_I)\text{)},\quad I\subseteq[n].$$
(The image lies in $\mathrm{SubMod}_n$ because Gaussian entropy is submodular.)

Solve the following:

(a) Characterize the image $H(\mathrm{PD}_n)\subseteq\mathrm{SubMod}_n$ as a semialgebraic subset of $\mathbb{R}^{2^{[n]}}$ (i.e. determine the algebraic and inequality conditions cutting out its closure).

(b) Describe how $H(\mathrm{PD}_n)$ intersects each face of the polyhedral cone $\mathrm{SubMod}_n$ (where faces are defined by setting collections of submodularity inequalities to equality).

(c) Describe the fibers $H^{-1}(h)$ for $h\in H(\mathrm{PD}_n)$: their dimension, topology, and any group action (e.g. by signed diagonal conjugation) whose orbits coincide with generic fibers.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem has been actively investigated. Subsequent work (e.g., El Maazouz on the Gaussian entropy map in valued fields, 2021; Ahmadieh–El Maazouz–Sturmfels et al., "Tropicalizing Principal Minors of Positive Definite Matrices," 2024) describes the tropicalization of the image and its relation to the submodular cone via matroid subdivisions, and produces new algebraic inequalities among principal minors. A complete semialgebraic description of the image, of its intersections with all faces of $\mathrm{SubMod}_n$, and of the fibers for general $n$ does not yet appear to be available, so the general problem remains only partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The Gaussian entropy map in valued fields
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the entropy map sending a positive definite matrix to logarithms of its principal minors and its tropicalization within the submodular cone.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on the image of the entropy map and its tropical structure.

status_evidence.title: Tropicalizing Principal Minors of Positive Definite Matrices
status_evidence.snippet: The tropicalization of the image of PD_n under the principal minors map intersects the submodular cone with structure given by matroid polytope subdivisions; new inequalities among principal minors are derived.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress on characterizing the image and its faces, but not a full solution.
